# S.U.N Reborn -- news
# Generated by Server\tools\make-feeds.ps1 -- do not hand-edit.
FORMAT 1

[2026-08-13] update | Valkyrie can field all three summons at once
Casting a summon used to dismiss whichever one you already had out, so a Valkyrie was stuck with a single pet no matter how many summons she had learned. That limit is gone.

How it works now:

- All three summons can be out at the same time, one per summon skill
- Re-casting a summon you already have out replaces that one only -- the other two stay where they are
- Ranking a summon up and casting it again swaps the old rank for the new one rather than stacking a second copy
- Every summon gets its own HP and mana bars and its own skill bar, stacked above the quick slots. Summoning a second one adds a set rather than replacing the first
- Summons now last a full hour instead of ten minutes
- Attack, Follow and Defend still apply to every summon at once

Summon skills are cast by clicking the slot on that summon's own bar. The old Shift+1..6 shortcut is gone -- with three summons out there was no way for a keypress to say which one it meant.

Summons carry through portals and zone changes exactly as before, keeping their remaining duration.

[2026-08-11] update | Premium enabled for all accounts
Every account now logs in with the premium flag set. That means the premium experience and item-find bonuses apply to everybody, all the time.

The Crystal Pillar buff, which normally sits behind a premium subscription, is included.

Nothing to claim and no command to type. Log in and it is already active.

[2026-08-11] update | The cash shop is now free
The entire item shop catalogue has been repriced to zero. Cosmetics, consumables, convenience items -- all of it, for everyone, from level one.

This is deliberate and permanent. There is no plan to introduce a paid tier later.

If a purchase does not appear in your inventory straight away, log out and back in once. The shop hands items over on the next session handshake.

[2026-08-11] announcement | The new website is live
Until now everything lived in a launcher window and a chat channel. This site replaces both.

What is here today:

- Account registration and password changes, straight from the browser
- Level, PK and guild rankings, read live from the game database
- Download mirrors and install instructions in one place
- This changelog, so you can see exactly what changed and when

Some of it stays dark until the server itself is reachable from the internet. Registration and rankings will switch on the moment that happens -- no new link to remember, the same pages just start working.
